mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds GDPC1 growth in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases > 100k & UNRATE rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% in a quarter signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals an economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods with sustained decreases in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters.
